defs.d: A midday meal (in a context in which the evening meal is called supper or tea).
The main meal of the day, often eaten in the evening.
To eat a dinner.
To provide (someone) with a dinner.
Offspring.
Lineage.
(ditransitive) To obtain; to acquire.
defs.ex: I'm going to get a computer tomorrow from the discount store.

defs.d: To receive.
defs.ex: He got a severe reprimand for that.

defs.d: (stative) To perceive sounds through the ear.
defs.ex: I was deaf, and now I can hear.

defs.d: (stative) To perceive (a sound, or something producing a sound) with the ear, to recognize (something) in an auditory way.
defs.ex: I heard a sound from outside the window.

defs.d: At no time; on no occasion; in no circumstance.
defs.ex: I finally finished, and I never want to do that again.

defs.d: Not at any other time; not on any other occasion; not previously.
(with "the") Those who have little or no possessions or money, taken as a group.
defs.ex: The poor are always with us.

defs.d: With no or few possessions or money, particularly in relation to contemporaries who do have them.
defs.ex: We were so poor that we couldn't afford shoes.

defs.d: Of low quality.
defs.ex: That was a poor performance.

defs.d: A female.
defs.ex: Pat is definitely a she.

defs.d: (personal) The female person or animal previously mentioned or implied.
defs.ex: After the cat killed a mouse, she left it on our doorstep.

defs.d: (personal, sometimes affectionate) A ship or boat.
defs.ex: She could do forty knots in good weather.

defs.d: The combination of circumstances at a given moment; a state of affairs.
defs.ex: The United States is in an awkward situation with debt default looming.

defs.d: The way in which something is positioned vis-à-vis its surroundings.
defs.ex: The Botanical Gardens are in a delightful situation on the river bank.

defs.d: Words or a formula supposed to have magical powers.
defs.ex: He cast a spell to cure warts.

defs.d: A magical effect or influence induced by an incantation or formula.
defs.ex: under a spell

defs.d: To put under the influence of a spell; to affect by a spell; to bewitch; to fascinate; to charm.
(of a function) Assuming each of the values in its codomain; having its range equal to its codomain.
defs.ex: Considered as a function on the real numbers, the exponential function is not onto.

defs.d: Upon; on top of.
defs.ex: My cat just jumped onto the keyboard.

defs.d: Aware of.
defs.ex: The thought-police were onto my plans of world domination.

defs.d: Resulting in success; assuring, or promoting, success; accomplishing what was proposed; having the desired effect
defs.ex: a successful use of medicine;  a successful experiment;  a successful enterprise

defs.d: A small ticket or sign giving information about something to which it is attached or intended to be attached.
defs.ex: Although the label priced this poster at three pounds, I got it for two.

defs.d: A name given to something or someone to categorise them as part of a particular social group.
defs.ex: Ever since he started going to the rock club, he's been given the label "waster".

defs.d: To put a label (a ticket or sign) on (something).
defs.ex: The shop assistant labeled all the products in the shop.

defs.d: (ditransitive) To give a label to (someone or something) in order to categorise that person or thing.
defs.ex: He's been unfairly labeled as a cheat, although he's only ever cheated once.

defs.d: In a direct manner; in a straight line or course.
defs.ex: He drove directly to the office, and didn't stop off at the petrol station.

defs.d: In a straightforward way; without anything intervening; not by secondary, but by direct means.
defs.ex: I'm sick of asking you to fire him, I'll just do it directly.

defs.d: As soon as; immediately.
The state of being responsible, accountable, or answerable.
defs.ex: Responsibility is a heavy burden.

defs.d: The state of being liable, culpable, or responsible for something in particular.

A small monastery or nunnery dependent on a larger religious establishment.
To place or enclose in a cell.
An act or instance of multiplying.
To increase the amount, degree or number of (something).
(with by) To perform multiplication on (a number).
defs.ex: when you multiply 3 by 7, you get 21;  he multiplied several numbers

defs.d: Determination; will power.
defs.ex: It took all my resolve to go through with the surgery.

defs.d: A determination to do something; a fixed decision.
To find a solution to (a problem).
To reduce to simple or intelligible notions; to make clear or certain; to unravel; to explain.
defs.ex: to resolve a riddle

defs.d: Relating to, or characteristic of life.
defs.ex: vital energies; vital functions; vital actions

defs.d: Necessary to the continuation of life; being the seat of life; being that on which life depends.
defs.ex: The brain is a vital organ.

To enclose or confine something on all sides so as to prevent escape.
An outlying area; area in proximity to something
An environment
